ingredientSections.heading: Duck Pappardelle
items: Braised duck legs and reduced braising liquid*
Salt to taste and for pasta water

methodSections.heading: Braised Duck Leg
steps: In a saucepan, bring the water to a boil with all ingredients, except for the duck, creating a braising liquid.
Place the duck legs in a small oven dish and cover with the braising liquid.
Cover the oven dish with a lid or tin foil.
Place in the oven until the meat falls off the bone, approximately 3 hours.
Remove from the oven and cool. Remove the duck from the braising liquid and pick the meat off the bones.
Strain the braising liquid and, in a pan, reduce by ¾.
Mix the reduced braising liquid with the picked duck meat and adjust the seasoning.

methodSections.heading: Pappardelle Pasta Dough
steps: Combine all the ingredients, except the semolina flour, in a stand mixer with a dough hook attachment and mix until the dough is smooth.
Let the dough rest for about 1 hour.
Using a pasta roller, roll the dough out to desired thickness and cut into pappardelle noodles, which are about 2-3cm (1in) thick.
Use the semolina flour to prevent the pasta from sticking to the roller and to itself.

methodSections.heading: Duck Pappardelle
steps: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to a boil for cooking the pasta.
In a sauté pan, add the braised duck legs and reduced braising liquid, butter, vinegar and sage.
Cook until the duck is hot and the sauce has formed enough to coat the pasta.
Cook the pasta in the water for about 3 minutes.
Drain the pasta and toss in the duck braise and pumpkin seeds.
Serve in bowls and top the dish with grated Grana Padano cheese.
